rateClassifications.rateDescription: Pay now. Change arrival date. Cancel up to 3 days before arrival.
rateClassifications.rateLongDescription:
In general, if you repay the price of what you bought within the delay period you won’t pay any interest. That’s because these periods are usually interest-free. If you use buy now pay later carefully you could delay paying for something for several months, or even a year, and not pay a penny in interest. Many of the big firms won’t charge you any interest if you clear your balance before your delay period is up – even if you only pay the day before.

Alternatively, some offers allow you to spread the cost over a longer period but interest may be charged at a high rate, for example 39.9% APR.
